wylie: ma grub na, rtag pa dang gcig chos can, dngos po dang 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod dngos po dang tha dad khyod yang yin dngos po yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med pa'i phyir
english: In that case, I disagree that something which is the same as something which is unchanging is contradictory to a working thing. Let's say that you do disagree. In that case, let us consider that which is the same as something which is unchanging. It is so contradictory to a working thing, Because (1) it is different from a working thing; and (2) there exists no example of something which is both it, and also a working thing.
